column1:
Showers or thundershowers are likely at a few places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Kankasanthurai to Pottuvil via Mannar, Puttalam, Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.

Winds will be South-westerly or Westerly. Wind speed will be (25-35) kmph. Wind speed can
increase up to (40-45) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Puttalam to
Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.

The sea areas off the coast extending from Puttalam to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and
Hambantota may be fairly rough at times. The other sea areas around the island may be slight or
Moderate.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.
